# Adafmt™

Adafmt™ is a professional Ada formatter for development teams that want safe, repeatable, configuration-driven formatting across real Ada codebases. The command-line tool is `adafmt`.

## Core positioning

Adafmt is a modern, high-performance, safety-oriented developer tool for Ada formatting. It provides configuration-driven style correction, syntax error detection, automatic backup behavior, and repeatable professional formatting results.

## In the Lab

Adafmt has been validated against relevant ACATS Ada 2012 tests, supplemental Ada 2022 feature tests, and real-world open-source Ada code. The largest test corpus contains more than 51,000 Ada files. Formatter validation emphasizes format success, idempotency, and stable output after repeated formatting.

## Current release status

Trial builds are planned. Initial targets are Linux x86_64 and Linux AArch64.
